extracted.intended_audience: general readers and literature enthusiasts interested in Pulitzer Prize history and controversial literary awards (booksellers, collectors, students of American literature)
extracted.subtask_description: A short-form blog post summarizing five historical controversies surrounding the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction, recounting cases where the jurors' choices were overturned or winners provoked public debate. The piece is narrative/history-focused rather than prescriptive or evaluative guidance.
